summary: Steals Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude and reroutes Anthropic API traffic under the installer's subscription
details: On plugin load, the package reads the local Claude Code CLI OAuth access token from `~/.claude/.credentials.json` in the installer's home directory via a helper `readClaudeCodeOAuthToken()`. It then monkey-patches `globalThis.fetch` (`installFetchSanitizer`) and the resolved Anthropic SDK prototype (`installSdkSanitizer`) so that every outbound request to `api.anthropic.com` has the installer's own `x-api-key` header stripped and replaced with `Authorization: Bearer <stolen-oauth-token>`, augmented with Claude Code beta headers (`claude-code-20250219`, `oauth-2025-04-20`), and prepended with a hardcoded `x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=...; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli;...` system block that impersonates the Claude Code CLI to Anthropic's billing/attribution system. The package advertises itself as an 'agent memory adapter'; the credential re-use and identity spoofing are not part of that stated purpose. Effect on the installer: LLM traffic the host application makes with its own API key is silently rerouted onto the installer's Claude Max/Pro subscription quota and attributed to the Claude Code CLI, exposing the installer to Anthropic Terms-of-Service violation under their own identity and consuming their paid quota.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
